question: What ritual attainments are attributed to the knower of this mantra?
premises: The knower is described as ritually accomplished
He is equated with bathing in all holy places
He is equated with initiation in all sacrifices
inference: The knower of this mantra is credited with the merit of all holy baths and all sacrificial initiations.
plain_english: He is as if bathed in all holy places and initiated in all sacrifices.
